/**
 * This array will contain lower-case strings of all header names that are
 * included in `mail.compose.other.header` but not in
 * `mailnews.headers.extraExpandedHeaders`, to be displayed only for
 * outgoing messages.
 */
var gCustomComposeHeaders = [];

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: initializeHeaderViewTables parses comma-separated mail.compose.other.header names, creates lower-case lookup keys and removes names also present in the space-separated extraExpandedHeaders preference from gCustomComposeHeaders. This gives explicitly expanded headers a broader display scope than compose-only headers. Keep case-insensitive comparisons and the two list formats separate when editing these prefs. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Separate compose-only custom headers from explicitly expanded headers
